'''Broll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Customs official/Legends|Customs]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] of the [[Republic Customs Office]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Hoth Orbital Station]] above [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] where he tried to inspect the [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]], who was smuggling [[Shariss Kartur]] off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a bulk of illegal Imperial salvage.

==Behind the scenes==
Three ways to deal with Broll are to offer him a bribe, attempt an unconvincing lie, or attack and kill him.
